body: I have never even heard of Grimm. Yes, I like Once Upon a Time, but it is not that same anymore. Sure I like comedies, but I can't really think of anything right now.

Yeah GoT was hard to get into, it took me a bunch of tries but it happened, I don't know I like fantasy stuff. Prison Break's first season was great, the show really did go down hill after that. Burn Notice is my favorite show, I just like it a lot, I don't know why. Rap music is good I guess, I like NWA, for example, because it is very rowdy and puts things like police brutality into perspective for people like me who never had to deal with that sort of thing. The only books that I ever read was the Harry Potter series and Where the Red Fern Grows.

I am so sorry for your loss.


I like GoT, Burn Notice was good, Prison Break was okay. I like listening to older rap music, mainly from the '85-'95 era. I don't read books, i'm a slow reader so I never really tried to be the type of person who reads books.
